heroBody: A startup founder takes the hot seat, opens up their business, and explains their biggest challenge. Then we dig in: a few other founders who have already solved that challenge in their own businesses.
This is the messy, uncomfortable process of solving a real puzzle faced by a real company. For the love of the game, for those in the arena.
site.askBody: is an AI that has sat through every episode and talk, so it can point you to the moment where we worked through your kind of problem. It isn’t me, and it shows its sources so you can check.
site.hotSeatBody: Every one of these founders opened up their real numbers. Here’s what each one was stuck on, in my words from the top of the episode.

book.title: Hidden Multipliers
book.subtitle: My best ideas for how to grow.
pitch: I founded two unicorns and invested in dozens of companies over 25 years. These are my best ideas: mechanisms that create outsized profit and growth, with your current budget and team.
Blogs and podcasts are mostly generic platitudes or tactics you can’t replicate. This book isn’t like that. It’s written for adults. You’re not in the 5th grade.
